title: Vibrant Spicy Egyptian Mirin-hon Tagine
description: A spicy, molten, and energizing Egyptian dish made using mirin-hon, perfect for halal-friendly meals.

ingredients.name: Red bell pepper
ingredients.notes: Any color bell pepper can be used

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: Any color onion can be used

ingredients.name: Cayenne pepper
ingredients.notes: Adjust the heat level to your preference

ingredients.name: Paprika
ingredients.notes: Any sweet or smoked paprika can be used

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Adjust the salt to your taste

instructions: Heat the olive oil in the tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the sliced onion and cook for 3-4 minutes until translucent.
Add the sliced red bell pepper and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Add the chicken breast and cook for 3-4 minutes until browned on all sides.
Add the cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the mirin-hon and stir to combine, then bring the mixture to a simmer.
Cover the tagine or Dutch oven and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Remove the tagine or Dutch oven from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs or lemon wedges, if desired.
